thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated OTLP export failures from otel-exporter -> honeycomb-ingest (service=telemetry-exporter). Errors rising suddenly across regions.

harry (oncall): seeing 429/503 spike across prod. paging mei and otto.

mei (sre): joining. quick check: exporter pods show surge in retries, memory up, queue length increasing. are these 429s with Retry-After or plain 503s?

otto (eng-telemetry): logs show mixed 429 with `Retry-After: 20` and `HTTP 503` connection resets. burst start ~1810507600 (~36m). We also had a brief auth key rotation on a background job at ~1810507000 which caused some 401s earlier but that was resolved. majority now are throttles from honeycomb.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1810509876 (otel-exporter -> Honeycomb - throttling/backpressure). Severity: P2. Paging policy: oncall -> sre -> eng-telemetry.

jana (support): support queue: two customers filed "missing traces" tickets; both included span IDs. No impact to user-facing latency or errors.

harry (oncall): immediate mitigations we can run: 1) sampling override to preserve only error/high-latency traces 2) enable disk-backed buffer on exporters and cap mem 3) add egress shaping to smooth retry storms 4) open vendor ticket with Honeycomb.

ome (eng-telemetry): implementing sampling override now: ```curl -X POST https://internal-config/v1/sampling -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG" -d '{"policy":"errors_only","duration":"40m"}'``` 
ome (eng-telemetry): sampling toggle applied; outbound export rate dropped ~62% within 90s. queues growth slowed.

mei (sre): applying disk buffer and memory cap: ```kubectl set env -n telemetry deploy/otel-exporter EXPORTER_BUFFER=disk EXPORTER_MAX_MEM=256Mi```

mei (sre): verifying pods mounted /var/otel/buffer and spool files are appearing. exporter memory usage dropping.

honeycomb-bot: We are investigating ingest throttling in multiple regions; 429s and backpressure observed. Status: https://status.honeycomb.io/incidents/klmn-otlp-throttle

harry (oncall): opened HC ticket HC-9120 with logs and sample span IDs. asked for per-org rate-limit details and ETA.

jana (support): sending proactive note to affected customers: "We're seeing partial trace delivery gaps due to third-party telemetry ingest throttling. We've applied mitigations (sampling + buffering) and will follow up with backfill plan once the vendor confirms. Update in 30m."

ome (eng-telemetry): rolling a global retry semaphore and hard cap on retries: set `MAX_RETRIES=6` and `RETRY_SEMAPHORE=48` in exporter config to avoid retry amplification. Rolling now.

mei (sre): also applied envoy egress rate limit for honeycomb host to smooth bursts: token-bucket at 350 rps per cluster. should reduce concurrent spikes hitting vendor.

honeycomb-bot: Update: we have applied short-term smoothing; 429 rates reduced in most tenants. Please provide org IDs if you still see issues.

harry (oncall): customer impact note for status page: - Traces: partial span loss for ~25% of traces in affected window (spans missing). - Metrics/logs: unaffected. - User-facing: no observed increase in error rate or latency.

jana (support): compiling affected org IDs and attaching span IDs to HC-9120. drafting customer follow-up.

ome (eng-telemetry): estimate buffered spans ~800k across clusters. replay capture enabled; we'll only backfill when honeycomb allows and we'll pace to avoid re-triggering limits (`max-replay-qps=40`).

mei (sre): handoff: I'm taking post-incident ownership after harry's oncall window. keep sampling + egress throttle until queue <10k and vendor confirms full recovery.

harry (oncall): agreed. leaving a couple of action items for the handoff: 1) gather exporter logs for last 3h 2) keep sampling toggled for 30-45m post vendor "fixed" 3) verify replay config and per-org pacing before backfill.

honeycomb-bot: Resolved: ingest smoothing completed; 429s returned to baseline. If you still observe throttling, please reply with org IDs.

mei (sre): monitoring shows queues draining and 429 percentage dropping. starting to plan RCA: root causes to investigate: retry amplification, missing circuit-breaker, lack of disk-backed buffer in earlier deployments, and unclear vendor per-org limits.

jana (support): will wait for HC confirmation on backfill window before sending final customer note.

harry (oncall): Handoff scheduled: harry (oncall) -> mei (sre) at 1810512150.

mei (sre): taking handoff. will run postmortem items: - add exporter queue alerts (warn at 100k spans, critical at 300k) - implement adaptive per-service sampling and fallback routing for critical services - add early circuit-breaker in exporter client - request vendor SLOs/quotas clarification and org-specific limits.

jana (support): preparing FAQ for customers about expected backfill, sampling effects, and how we will surface restored traces.

harry (oncall): thanks team. good coordination. closing active pages; RCA and postmortem to follow.
